_README: ONE config file drives the whole pipeline. Copy this to config.json (gitignored) and edit it. Every field has a default — only override what you need to change. See docs/CONFIG_GUIDE.md for field-by-field documentation.
feasibility_prompt: A job is PREFERRED if it is a senior engineering leadership role (Senior Manager, Sr. Manager, Director, VP, Head of, Senior Director) at a well-known tech company where the work involves building/managing software products or platforms at scale. A job is YES if it is a senior engineering leadership role at a legitimate software, internet, platform, or AI/ML company where the work involves building/managing software products or platforms. A job is NO if it is: a non-software leadership role, an IC role without people-leadership, a junior/mid-level role, or in a non-tech industry. Customize this prompt to match your target roles and companies.
